profile.headline: Senior Software Developer  at Bloomberg LP
profile.summary:
Innovative software engineer offering more than fifteen years hands-on experience in the full software development lifecycle – from concept through delivery of next-generation applications and customizable solutions

Expert in application design and implementation in Windows and Linux system for communication, data acquisition, archiving and embedded systems as well as in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) algorithm development. 

Known for excellent troubleshooting skills – able to analyze code and engineer well-researched effective and responsive solutions.
